question: Who was the founder of the Mauryan Empire and established a centralised administrative system?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the founder of the **Mauryan Empire**, which marked the beginning of a unified and centralized administration in ancient India.
 
• He established the empire in around **321 BCE**, after overthrowing the Nanda dynasty with the assistance of his mentor and strategist, **Chanakya (Kautilya).**
